card.name: Anti- before antibody target names
card.fires_on: The word "anti" (or the hyphen after it) right before a target name such as JCV, GBM, platelet or neutrophilic, where an antibody is being named. It also fires on a few other words that come just before the word antibodies.

modes.label: Anti- in antibody names
modes.description: The prefix anti after "presence of" or in a disease name, leading into a target and then the word antibodies.

modes.label: Other antibody-related words
modes.description: Words or marks just before an antibody or blood-group term, such as circulating or K in Kell.

card.writes: It suppresses immunoglobulin-type word starts (immun, glob, Ig, album), so it seems to steer the model away from those and toward antibody target names.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a label like "anti-JCV" is about to name what an antibody attacks.
